title: Japanese Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make wrap filled with juicy chicken and crunchy vegetables. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Japanese wrap
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a gluten-free tortilla

ingredients.name: aromatic vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, bell peppers, and onions

ingredients.name: japanese sauce
ingredients.notes: such as teriyaki or soy sauce

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper, and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Slice the chicken into thin strips and set aside.
Warm the Japanese wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the Japanese sauce on the wrap, then topping with the chicken, aromatic vegetables, and tender green.
